reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: Millimeters assumed; STL has no units

adaptation.newInterfaces: Blind 0.8mm-floor perimeter pockets, outward offset c/2; matching tiles inward offset c/2. Source .10mm thickness allowance informs proposed .10–.30mm edge allowance, not identical fit.
adaptation.newGeometry: Two-piece vertical-cut parallelogram dissection with triangular wedge translated by W to form rectangle. Two trays + two pieces, 16 runners, no hardware or glue.
adaptation.nominalInvariant: Area(parallelogram)=Area(rectangle)=W*H; finger bores and clearance remove plastic.
adaptation.assembly: Lift both pieces above rims; shift to second tray, move wedge one extra W without rotation; lower vertically.
adaptation.differencesFromEarlierApps: Not a bar-length comparison, tessellation-code tray or Pythagorean four-triangle proof. Exact two-piece shear dissection uses a translating wedge and fixed remainder with two distinct pocket polygons.
